title: About
description:
Hi, I'm Toyi Fabrice, a Full-Stack developer based in Lomé, Togo. For more than three years, I've been designing, building and deploying web applications end to end — from requirements analysis all the way to production.

As the founder and solo maker of micro-ats.com, I like taking full ownership of a product and shipping it properly, all the way. Alongside that, I teach tech on YouTube ({subscribers} subscribers), train students and help young graduates land their first job.
